name: Modeled boost into chainsaw (pedal.ts + pedal.hm)
notes: Green overdrive model (pedal.ts: drive 2, tone 6, level 8) as a tightening boost in front of the HM model at moderate settings. Single path, no captures: renders from files in this repo only.
